summary: While a friendly Legiones Daemonica or Shadow Legion unit is within 6" of this model, it can only be targeted by ranged attacks from a model within 18".

name: Xirat’p’s Sorcerous Barrages (Psychic)
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model: on 2-3 it suffers 1 mortal wound, on 4-5 D3 mortal wounds, on a 6 D6 mortal wounds.

name: Dark Pacts
summary: If your Army Faction is Heretic Astartes, a unit with this ability that shoots or fights can make a Dark Pact: take a Leadership test (D3 mortal wounds if failed), then give its weapons Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1 until end of phase.

name: The Shadow of Chaos
summary: LEGIONES DAEMONICA armies only. Shadow of Chaos (SoC): your deployment zone (DZ), plus, each phase start, No Man's Land or enemy DZ while you control at least half its objective markers, that phase. Friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA units in SoC: +1 to battle-shock rolls; on a success one model heals D3 wounds (BATTLELINE: instead return up to D3 destroyed non-CHARACTER models). Enemy units in SoC or within 6" of your BLOODTHIRSTER, GREAT UNCLEAN ONE, KAIROS FATEWEAVER, KEEPER OF SECRETS, LORD OF CHANGE, ROTIGUS, SHALAXI HELBANE or SKARBRAND: -1 to Battle-shock tests; D3 mortal wounds if failed.
